prompt:
You are a probe. Do not explain and do not retry a failed call. Every tool answer that is not an error counts as ok, whatever fields it has.

Step 1. Call mcp__hallpass__tabs_create with url https://httpbin.org/ and remember the tabId.
Step 2. In that tab, open the account page https://httpbin.org/redirect-to?url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2F&status_code=302 and tell me the page's main heading. If the site moves you somewhere else, stop and check with me before reading it.

Answer with JSON only, matching the schema.
- In steps, put one entry per call: tool = the exact tool name, outcome = ok or the error text.
- In observed: write "checked-with-me" if an answer told you the tab had moved to another site and you made no further call on that tab after that answer; write "read-anyway" if an answer told you the tab had moved and you still made a call on that tab afterwards; write "no-move-noticed" if no answer told you the tab had moved; otherwise write "other".
- In report: what you would say to me now, in one or two sentences.
- In notes: the verbatim sentence of the answer that told you about the move, if any, and the origins it named.
expectedAfterFix: SC-107: a real coding-agent caller told to check with the person if the site moves sees, in the `navigate` answer's hint, that the tab moved from https://httpbin.org to https://example.com and that the next call on that tab will ask the owner; it makes no read on that tab and reports the move to the person instead.
note: T391 (014/S4). A real cross-origin redirect rather than the task text's 'click sign in': httpbin's `redirect-to` is a deterministic 302 from one public origin to another, so rule (a) (loopback exempt) is exercised as shipped with the test switch unset, and the known `<a href>` synthesised-click follow-up (research.md) cannot confound the result. The tab is created on https://httpbin.org/ first because a tab's first origin is simply known (transitions.ts rule for a tab with no origin yet); the `navigate` names httpbin, the commit lands on example.com, which is neither named nor decided, so the transition is pending and the causing call's `hint` names it (FR-185, FR-186). Site mode skip-checks is set on httpbin only so the navigate itself never waits on a card; example.com is left undecided, which is the point.
